# EroHub NSFW Detection API -- Full LLM Reference
# Base URL: https://your-domain.com (or http://localhost:8000 for dev)
# Auth: API key as Bearer token in Authorization header
# All image endpoints accept multipart/form-data with field "file"
# Box format: [x, y, width, height] (xywh) for all models
# Max upload: 50MB images, 200MB videos (auth users), 10MB/50MB (demo)
# Max video duration: 300s (auth unlimited, demo 30s)

## Authentication
All endpoints except /demo/*, /health, /models, /storage/* require:
  Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx

API keys are validated against the auth service. Usage is logged per key.
Demo endpoints use IP-based rate limiting instead of API keys.

## Detection Models

NudeNet (nudenet) -- YOLOv8m, 640m.onnx (98.7MB), 18 labels:
  FEMALE_BREAST_EXPOSED, FEMALE_BREAST_COVERED,
  FEMALE_GENITALIA_EXPOSED, FEMALE_GENITALIA_COVERED,
  MALE_GENITALIA_EXPOSED, MALE_GENITALIA_COVERED,
  BUTTOCKS_EXPOSED, BUTTOCKS_COVERED,
  ANUS_EXPOSED, ANUS_COVERED,
  BELLY_EXPOSED, BELLY_COVERED,
  ARMPITS_EXPOSED, ARMPITS_COVERED,
  FEET_EXPOSED, FEET_COVERED,
  FACE_FEMALE, FACE_MALE
  Default censor labels: FEMALE_BREAST_EXPOSED, FEMALE_GENITALIA_EXPOSED, MALE_GENITALIA_EXPOSED, BUTTOCKS_EXPOSED, ANUS_EXPOSED

EraX (erax) -- YOLO11s (18.3MB), 5 labels:
  NIPPLE, PENIS, VAGINA, ANUS, MAKE_LOVE
  Default censor labels: NIPPLE, PENIS, VAGINA, ANUS

CLIP (clip-vit-base-patch32, 350MB) -- used for sexiness scoring, age estimation, deepfake detection, clothing classification, embeddings, zero-shot tagging. Lazy-loaded on first use.

## Error Format
All errors return JSON: {"detail": "Human-readable error message"}
Status codes:
  400 -- Bad request (invalid image, no labels, unsupported format)
  401 -- Unauthorized (missing or invalid API key)
  404 -- Not found (image not found, no NSFW scenes)
  413 -- Payload too large (file exceeds size limit)
  429 -- Rate limited (demo IP limit exceeded)
  503 -- Service unavailable (CLIP not loaded, demo service not ready)

## Cache Behavior
Endpoints /classify, /rateme, /moderate support caching.
- Cache key: sha256(image_bytes) + model_version + endpoint
- Cache is checked before ML inference. Pass ?no_cache=1 to bypass.
- Response header X-Cache: HIT (from cache) or MISS (fresh inference)
- Cache TTL: 30 days (configurable via CACHE_TTL_DAYS env)
- Cache layers: Redis (if available) -> Database fallback

## Rate Limiting
Auth users: rate limits based on tenant plan (free/starter/business/enterprise).
Demo users: IP-based, 10 images/hour, 1 archive/hour.
3-tier implementation: Redis -> DB -> In-memory fallback.

## Webhook Payloads
Webhooks fire on classify, rateme, moderate events. HMAC-signed (SHA256).
Retries: immediate, then 1m, 5m, 30m (max 4 attempts).
Headers on webhook POST:
  Content-Type: application/json
  X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=<hmac_hex>
  X-Webhook-Timestamp: <unix_timestamp>
  X-Webhook-Event: detection.classify | detection.rateme | detection.moderate
Payload:
{
  "event": "detection.classify",
  "tenant_id": "uuid",
  "timestamp": 1700000000,
  "detection": { <full endpoint response> }
}

## Endpoints -- Authenticated

### POST /classify
Detect NSFW content in an image. Returns detection boxes + CLIP analysis.
Content-Type: multipart/form-data
Fields: file (required)
Query params: model=nudenet|erax (default: nudenet), no_cache=0|1
Response (200):
{
  "image_id": "20240101_120000_a1b2c3d4",
  "model": "nudenet",
  "detections": [
    {
      "label": "FEMALE_BREAST_EXPOSED",
      "score": 0.9234,
      "box": [120, 200, 80, 90],
      "box_format": "xywh"
    }
  ],
  "age": {
    "estimated_age": 25.3,
    "bracket": "young_adult",
    "confidence": 0.4521,
    "is_minor_risk": false,
    "available": true
  },
  "deepfake": {
    "fake_probability": 0.1234,
    "is_likely_fake": false,
    "verdict": "likely_real",
    "available": true
  },
  "clothing": {
    "clothing": "lingerie",
    "exposure_level": 0.65,
    "scores": {"formal":0.01, "casual":0.05, "swimwear":0.12, "lingerie":0.45, "dress":0.03, "sportswear":0.02, "minimal":0.22, "nude":0.10},
    "available": true
  }
}
Headers: X-Cache: HIT|MISS

### POST /censor
Blur NSFW regions. Returns censored image as PNG.
Content-Type: multipart/form-data
Fields: file (required), labels (optional, comma-separated label names to censor)
Query params: model=nudenet|erax
Response (200): image/png binary
Response headers:
  X-Image-Id: 20240101_120000_a1b2c3d4
  X-Estimated-Age: 25.3
  X-Minor-Risk: False
  X-Deepfake-Verdict: likely_real
  X-Clothing: lingerie

### POST /rateme
Multi-factor sexiness/attractiveness scoring. Runs NudeNet + EraX + CLIP.
Content-Type: multipart/form-data
Fields: file (required)
Query params: no_cache=0|1
Response (200):
{
  "image_id": "20240101_120000_a1b2c3d4",
  "models": ["nudenet", "erax"],
  "rating": {
    "score": 0.6234,
    "category": "sensual",
    "description": "Sensual content",
    "factors": {
      "clip_sexiness": {"score": 0.72, "weight": 0.38, "available": true},
      "eroticism": {"score": 0.55, "weight": 0.27, "breakdown": [{"label":"FEMALE_BREAST_EXPOSED","confidence":0.92,"weight":0.75,"contribution":0.69}]},
      "image_quality": {"score": 0.81, "weight": 0.12, "resolution": 0.95, "sharpness": 0.78, "brightness": 0.88, "contrast": 0.63},
      "composition": {"score": 0.65, "weight": 0.10, "has_face": true, "aspect_ratio": 0.75, "centering": 0.82, "pose": {"score": 0.45, "details": "..."}},
      "aesthetics": {"score": 0.70, "weight": 0.08, "saturation": 0.65, "color_variety": 0.72, "noise_level": 0.15},
      "age_attractiveness": {"score": 1.0, "weight": 0.05, "estimated_age": 24, "available": true}
    },
    "age": {"estimated_age": 24.0, "bracket": "young_adult", "confidence": 0.45, "is_minor_risk": false, "available": true},
    "deepfake": {"fake_probability": 0.12, "is_likely_fake": false, "verdict": "likely_real", "available": true},
    "clothing": {"clothing": "lingerie", "exposure_level": 0.65, "scores": {...}, "available": true}
  },
  "detections": [...]
}
Headers: X-Cache: HIT|MISS
Factor weights: clip_sexiness=38%, eroticism=27%, image_quality=12%, composition=10%, aesthetics=8%, age_attractiveness=5%
If CLIP unavailable: clip_sexiness(38%) + age_attractiveness(5%) shift to eroticism (total 70%)
Categories: safe(0-0.10), mild(0.10-0.25), suggestive(0.25-0.45), sensual(0.45-0.65), erotic(0.65-0.80), explicit(0.80-0.92), extreme(0.92-1.0), blocked(minor detected)
Minor safety: if minor detected, score forced to 0, category set to "blocked"

### POST /moderate
All-in-one content moderation. Runs NudeNet + EraX + CLIP in parallel.
Content-Type: multipart/form-data
Fields: file (required)
Query params: no_cache=0|1
Response (200):
{
  "image_id": "20240101_120000_a1b2c3d4",
  "action": "flag",
  "confidence": 0.82,
  "reasons": ["erotic content detected (score 0.72)", "nudity detected: FEMALE_BREAST_EXPOSED (confidence 92%)"],
  "detections": [...],
  "rating": {"score": 0.72, "category": "erotic", "description": "Erotic content", "factors": {...}},
  "clip_analysis": {
    "sexiness": {"score": 0.72, "available": true},
    "age": {"estimated_age": 25.3, "bracket": "young_adult", "is_minor_risk": false, "available": true},
    "deepfake": {"fake_probability": 0.12, "verdict": "likely_real", "available": true},
    "clothing": {"clothing": "lingerie", "exposure_level": 0.65, "available": true}
  },
  "summary": {
    "nudity_score": 0.65,
    "violence_score": 0,
    "text_flags": []
  }
}
Action logic:
  "block" -- minor risk, extreme category, sexual act with >70% confidence
  "flag" -- erotic/explicit content, likely_fake deepfake, significant nudity, suggestive/sensual content
  "allow" -- no concerning content detected
Headers: X-Cache: HIT|MISS

### POST /batch
Process ZIP/RAR archive. Classifies all images inside.
Content-Type: multipart/form-data
Fields: file (required, ZIP or RAR archive)
Query params: model=nudenet|erax
Response (200):
{
  "model": "nudenet",
  "total": 5,
  "processed": 4,
  "errors": 1,
  "results": [
    {"filename": "img1.jpg", "image_id": "20240101_120000_a1b2c3d4", "detections": [...]},
    {"filename": "corrupt.jpg", "error": "Invalid image", "detections": []}
  ]
}

### POST /embed
CLIP embedding vector for an image.
Fields: file (required)
Query params: normalize=true|false (default: true)
Response (200):
{
  "image_id": "20240101_120000_a1b2c3d4",
  "embedding": [0.0123, -0.0456, ...],
  "dimensions": 768,
  "model": "clip-vit-base-patch32",
  "normalized": true
}

### POST /compare
Cosine similarity between two images via CLIP embeddings.
Fields: file1, file2 (both required, multipart)
Response (200):
{
  "similarity": 0.8723,
  "is_similar": true,
  "embedding_model": "clip-vit-base-patch32"
}
Threshold: is_similar=true when similarity >= 0.85

### POST /tag
Zero-shot labeling. Score image against custom text labels using CLIP.
Fields: file (multipart), labels (form field, comma-separated, max 50 labels, max 200 chars each)
Response (200):
{
  "image_id": "20240101_120000_a1b2c3d4",
  "tags": [
    {"label": "beach scene", "score": 0.6234},
    {"label": "portrait", "score": 0.2156},
    {"label": "indoor photo", "score": 0.1610}
  ],
  "model": "clip-vit-base-patch32"
}

### POST /faces
Detect faces (MediaPipe). Returns face locations as JSON.
Fields: file (required)
Response (200):
{
  "image_id": "20240101_120000_a1b2c3d4",
  "faces": [{"box": [100, 50, 80, 90], "score": 0.98}],
  "count": 1
}

### POST /anonymize
Detect and blur faces. Returns anonymized PNG image.
Fields: file (required)
Query params: blur_radius=40 (5-200)
Response (200): image/png binary
Headers: X-Faces-Found: 2, X-Image-Id: 20240101_120000_a1b2c3d4

### POST /pose
Estimate body pose (MediaPipe). Returns keypoints and analysis.
Fields: file (required)
Response (200):
{
  "image_id": "20240101_120000_a1b2c3d4",
  "pose": { ... }
}

### POST /video/classify
Classify video frame by frame. No size/duration limits for auth users.
Fields: file (required, video file)
Query params: model=nudenet|erax, fps=1.0 (0.1-30), max_frames=0 (0=unlimited)
Supported formats: .mp4, .avi, .mov, .mkv, .webm, .flv, .wmv
Response (200):
{
  "video_id": "20240101_120000_a1b2c3d4",
  "model": "nudenet",
  "video_info": {"duration": 45.2, "width": 1920, "height": 1080, "fps": 30.0},
  "settings": {"analyze_fps": 1.0, "max_frames": 0, "frames_analyzed": 45},
  "frames": [
    {"timestamp": 0.0, "detections": [{"label": "FEMALE_BREAST_EXPOSED", "score": 0.92, "box": [120,200,80,90], "box_format": "xywh"}]},
    {"timestamp": 1.0, "detections": []}
  ],
  "summary": {
    "total_detections": 12,
    "labels_found": {"FEMALE_BREAST_EXPOSED": 8, "BUTTOCKS_EXPOSED": 4},
    "max_score": 0.9534,
    "nsfw_frames": 10,
    "nsfw_percentage": 22.2
  }
}

### POST /video/censor
Censor video -- detect and blur NSFW regions. Returns MP4.
Fields: file (required), labels (form, optional, comma-separated)
Query params: model, fps=5.0 (0.1-30), max_frames=0, blur_radius=60 (5-200), interpolate=true
Response (200): video/mp4 binary
Headers: X-Video-Id, X-Frames-Analyzed, X-Detections-Found

### POST /video/scenes
Extract NSFW scenes as compiled highlight video. Returns MP4.
Fields: file (required)
Query params: model, fps=2.0 (0.5-10), min_scene_duration=2.0 (>=0.5s), scene_padding=1.0 (>=0s)
Response (200): video/mp4 binary
Headers:
  X-Video-Id: 20240101_120000_a1b2c3d4
  X-Scenes-Found: 3
  X-Total-Duration: 120.50
  X-Scenes-Duration: 28.40
  X-Scenes-Metadata: [{"index":0,"start":12.5,"end":22.3,"duration":9.8},...]
Error 404: "No NSFW scenes detected in video."

### GET /images
List stored images.
Query params: category=censored|originals (default: censored), limit=50 (max 200)
Response (200):
{
  "category": "censored",
  "images": [
    {"id": "20240101_120000_a1b2c3d4", "filename": "20240101_120000_a1b2c3d4.png", "size": 245000, "created": "2024-01-01T12:00:00+00:00"}
  ]
}

### GET /images/{category}/{image_id}
Retrieve stored image by ID. category=originals|censored
Response: image file (FileResponse)

### GET /storage/{category}/{filename}
Public image access by full filename. No auth required. IDs contain UUID, not guessable.
category=originals|censored
Response: image file (FileResponse)

### GET /health
No auth required.
Response (200):
{
  "status": "ok",
  "models": {"nudenet": true, "erax": true},
  "workers": {"pool_size": 2, "active": 0}
}

### GET /models
No auth required.
Response (200):
{
  "models": [
    {"id": "nudenet", "name": "NudeNet 640m", "description": "YOLOv8m -- 18 labels, covered + exposed distinction", "labels": [...], "default_censor": [...]},
    {"id": "erax", "name": "EraX Anti-NSFW v1.1", "description": "YOLO11s -- 5 labels, higher accuracy, exposed only", "labels": [...], "default_censor": [...]}
  ]
}

## Endpoints -- Demo (no auth, IP rate limited)

All demo endpoints return extra fields: "demo": true, "limits": {images_remaining, archives_remaining, reset_in}
Demo rate limits: 10 images/hour, 1 archive/hour per IP.
Demo max upload: 10MB images, 50MB videos/archives.
Demo video limit: max 30 seconds, max 20 frames.

### POST /demo/classify
Same as /classify but no auth, IP rate limited, no CLIP analysis.
Params: model=nudenet|erax
Response: {model, detections, image_id, demo:true, limits:{...}}

### POST /demo/rateme
Same as /rateme but no auth, IP rate limited.
Response: {models, rating, detections, demo:true, limits:{...}}

### POST /demo/moderate
Same as /moderate but no auth, IP rate limited.
Response: {action, confidence, reasons, detections, rating, clip_analysis, summary, demo:true, limits:{...}}

### POST /demo/batch
Same as /batch but no auth, max 10 images per archive, 1 archive/hour.
Response: {model, total, processed, results, demo:true, limits:{...}}

### POST /demo/embed
Same as /embed but no auth, IP rate limited.
Response: {image_id, embedding, dimensions, model, normalized, demo:true, limits:{...}}

### POST /demo/compare
Same as /compare but no auth, counts as 2 images against rate limit.
Response: {similarity, is_similar, embedding_model, demo:true, limits:{...}}

### POST /demo/tag
Same as /tag but no auth, IP rate limited.
Response: {image_id, tags, model, demo:true, limits:{...}}

### POST /demo/faces
Same as /faces but no auth, IP rate limited.
Response: {image_id, faces, count, demo:true, limits:{...}}

### POST /demo/anonymize
Same as /anonymize but no auth, IP rate limited.
Response: image/png with headers X-Faces-Found, X-Image-Id

### POST /demo/pose
Same as /pose but no auth, IP rate limited.
Response: {image_id, pose, demo:true, limits:{...}}

### POST /demo/video/classify
Same as /video/classify but no auth, max 30s video, max 20 frames, fps max 5.0.
Response: same as /video/classify plus {demo:true, limits:{...}}

### POST /demo/video/scenes
Same as /video/scenes but no auth, max 30s video, max 20 frames, fps max 5.0.
Response: video/mp4 with same headers as /video/scenes

### GET /demo/limits
Check remaining demo rate limits for current IP.
Response: {images_remaining: 8, archives_remaining: 1, reset_in: 2400}

### GET /demo/admin/usage
Super admin endpoint. Live demo usage from memory.
Response: {demo_users: {...}}

## curl Examples

# Classify an image
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/classify \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file=@photo.jpg"

# Classify with EraX model
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/classify?model=erax \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file=@photo.jpg"

# Bypass cache
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/classify?no_cache=1 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file=@photo.jpg"

# Censor specific labels only
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/censor \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file=@photo.jpg" \
  -F "labels=FEMALE_BREAST_EXPOSED,FEMALE_GENITALIA_EXPOSED" \
  -o censored.png

# Rate an image
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/rateme \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file=@photo.jpg"

# Moderate an image
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/moderate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file=@photo.jpg"

# Get CLIP embedding
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/embed \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file=@photo.jpg"

# Compare two images
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/compare \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file1=@photo1.jpg" \
  -F "file2=@photo2.jpg"

# Zero-shot tagging
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/tag \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file=@photo.jpg" \
  -F "labels=beach scene,indoor photo,portrait,landscape,selfie"

# Detect faces
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/faces \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file=@photo.jpg"

# Anonymize faces
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/anonymize?blur_radius=60 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file=@photo.jpg" \
  -o anonymous.png

# Classify video
curl -X POST "http://localhost:8000/video/classify?fps=2&model=nudenet" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file=@video.mp4"

# Censor video
curl -X POST "http://localhost:8000/video/censor?fps=5&blur_radius=80" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file=@video.mp4" \
  -o censored.mp4

# Extract NSFW scenes
curl -X POST "http://localhost:8000/video/scenes?min_scene_duration=3&scene_padding=1.5" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file=@video.mp4" \
  -o scenes.mp4

# Batch process archive
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/batch?model=nudenet \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ehk_xxxxx" \
  -F "file=@images.zip"

# Demo classify (no auth)
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/demo/classify \
  -F "file=@photo.jpg"

# Check demo limits
curl http://localhost:8000/demo/limits

# Health check
curl http://localhost:8000/health
